description: Canonical NZ pantry ingredients for Chef Llama chip canonicalizer, planned D1 ingredients table, and future Vectorize embeddings.

id_policy.slug: Stable external key (kebab-case). Unique. Used by chip canonicalizer and Try me wiring.
id_policy.d1_id: On load into RECIPES_DB, each row also gets a ULID primary key (see docs/data.md). Slug stays UNIQUE.
id_policy.vectorize: Embed name + aliases; metadata includes slug (and ULID after D1 load).

avoid_model.summary: Cook lists ingredients to avoid. Code blocks chips whose slug or alias matches, and expands small parent links (e.g. dairy, wheat). UI tells Cooks they must check their own product labels — the seed is not a medical allergen database.

intrinsic_flags_note: Composition flags only. vegan = none of the five; vegetarian = no meat/fish and no vegetarian-blocking animal_derived (gelatine, lard, …). Honey is animal_derived but vegetarian-OK. gluten_free / keto / halal / paleo are AI rules + label disclaimer — not per-item tags.
diet_flags_note: Derived from intrinsic flags. Other Diet preferences (gluten_free, keto, halal, paleo) are short rules for the AI plus the label disclaimer — not stored on pantry rows.
